author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices the hand home, three hops and a twirl, an octave leap, two endings, a low left hand beat and speeding up, with a dance.

classes.title: Kick! Thumb on C
classes.goal: Find the hand home on C and play the first 'kick' line slowly.

mathTarget.parentLine: Using the two black keys to place the whole hand

classes.parentPrompt: Point to the two black keys; help your child rest the thumb on C and curve the fingers.
classes.childAction: Hold C long like a kick, then D, F, E, D.
classes.bridge: C is the dancer's starting spot, left of the two black keys.

intro.caption: Kick! Thumb on C
intro.parentCue: point to the two black keys first

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: placing the whole hand with a landmark.

classes.title: Three hops and a twirl
classes.goal: Play the clap line: three walking notes, then four quick ones.

mathTarget.parentLine: Three slow hops, then quick notes twice as fast

classes.parentPrompt: Clap three times with your child, then wiggle your fingers fast for the twirl.
classes.childAction: Finger 2 hops D three times, then twirls F, E, D.
classes.bridge: Hop, hop, hop are walking steps; the twirl is run-ning feet, twice as fast.

intro.caption: Three hops and a twirl
intro.parentCue: Clap three times together, then wiggle fingers

games.caption: Hop, hop, hop and twirl
games.parentCue: Count one, two, three on the hops

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: slow notes and notes twice as fast.

classes.title: Same dance, two endings
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly and notice the dance comes twice, with new endings.

mathTarget.parentLine: The dance repeats, but the first and second endings differ

classes.parentPrompt: Run your fingers up and down at the first ending; take a bow at the second.
classes.childAction: Play slowly; first ending runs the stairs, second ending bows.
classes.bridge: The dance goes round twice: first it runs the stairs, then it takes a bow.

intro.caption: Same dance, two endings
intro.parentCue: Bow together when the second ending comes

games.caption: Tap the beat: the first line
games.parentCue: Play the blue keys; your child taps the beat

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing a repeat with two endings.

classes.title: Leap up, run down
classes.goal: Practise the stairs line: a big leap from C to high C, then running down.

mathTarget.parentLine: Jumping eight keys up to the same note, then stepping down

classes.parentPrompt: Watch the leap together, then help your child play the last four steps down.
classes.childAction: Watch the big leap, then run down G, F, E, D.
classes.bridge: Low C leaps to high C, the same name one house up, then runs downstairs.

intro.caption: Watch slowly
intro.parentCue: Same name, different house: point to both Cs

games.caption: Leap up to high C
games.parentCue: Point to both Cs, then count the steps down

games.caption: Run down: G, F, E, D

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: an octave leap and running down.

classes.title: Big boots on one
classes.goal: Play one low left hand note, C or G, at the start of each bar.

mathTarget.parentLine: Four beats in each bar; the left hand plays on one

classes.parentPrompt: Play the tune; count one-two-three-four, loud on one, for your child's low note.
classes.childAction: Left hand stomps low C or low G on every one.
classes.bridge: Low C is C in a lower house; it stomps like big dancing boots.

intro.caption: Big boots on one
intro.parentCue: count to four, loud on one

games.caption: Stomp on one
games.parentCue: Stomp a foot gently with each low note

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: counting four beats and playing on one.

classes.title: Keep the boots going
classes.goal: Keep the low left hand notes going at full speed under the tune.

mathTarget.parentLine: Keeping a steady part going while the music runs fast

classes.parentPrompt: Play the tune at full speed; if your child misses a one, keep going and smile.
classes.childAction: Keep stomping low notes on one, even when it is fast.
classes.bridge: The tune races; your low notes are the floor the dancers land on.

intro.caption: Keep the boots going
intro.parentCue: keep going even if a note is missed

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping your part steady at speed.

classes.title: Boots and quick feet
classes.goal: Play the tune with a low left hand note on each bar, very slowly.

mathTarget.parentLine: One low note lasts while four beats go by above

classes.parentPrompt: Rest a hand on your child's left shoulder and say 'boot' on each low note.
classes.childAction: Left hand stomps and holds; right hand dances the tune.
classes.bridge: Left hand is the big boot, still and low; right hand is the quick feet.

intro.caption: Boots and quick feet
intro.parentCue: Say 'boot' softly on each low note

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: two hands doing two jobs at once.

classes.title: Faster and faster
classes.goal: Play both hands together a little faster, then slow again if needed.

mathTarget.parentLine: The pattern stays the same when the speed changes

classes.parentPrompt: Tap the lid slowly, then faster, with your child; go back to slow if notes fall apart.
classes.childAction: Play both hands slowly, then a little quicker.
classes.bridge: A dance can be a slow walk or a giggly gallop: same steps, new speed.

intro.caption: Faster and faster
intro.parentCue: Go back to slow if notes fall apart

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: the same song at two speeds.

classes.title: Dance with the band
classes.goal: Play the whole song along with the music at full speed and keep going.

mathTarget.parentLine: Keeping your part in step while the music moves on

classes.parentPrompt: Sit beside your child and nod on every one; cheer for keeping going, not for notes.
classes.childAction: Dance along with the music. If a note slips, keep dancing!
classes.bridge: The band is the dance floor; keep your feet moving to the end.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping your part in step with the music.

classes.title: Take a bow, the end!
classes.goal: Play the whole dance for teddy and take a bow on the very last note.

mathTarget.parentLine: Holding the song in order and landing on the home note

classes.parentPrompt: Seat teddy as the audience; on 'take a bow', bow together and cheer.
classes.childAction: Play for teddy, land on C, then take a big bow.
classes.bridge: The last line even says it: take a bow, the end, home on C.

intro.caption: A song for teddy
intro.parentCue: Seat teddy and announce the dance together

games.caption: Take a bow, the end
games.parentCue: Sing 'take a bow, the end' together

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song and ending at home.
